title: Lantern SMP Official Pack
body:
This is the first pack created for Lantern SMP, a modded Minecraft server that is currently in Beta. Our goal with Lantern SMP is to create a builder safe and friendly environment for all. We will also have a pack on Curseforge!

Lantern SMP includes a realtively basic mod list aimed for a survival experience with the added touches of magic, both to make life easier and more interesting! Including Waystones for long distance travel, Traveler's Backpack to allow better storage, and Kaleidoscope Tavern for the addedd blocks and items! This modpack also includes Simple Voice Chat, Xaero's World and Mini Map, JEI, Mod Menu, LambDynamicLights, (Bee's) Fancy Crops(Resource Pack), and Locator Heads. The pack also contains all needed packs, including geckolib, shogi, balm, and konkrete for example so everything works correctly. Please join the Discord Server if your looking for the full mod list that the SMP itself is running serverside :) 


You will also average around 55-60 frames depending on your computer, but on lower end ones it should still work realitvely well and without lag, just with a lower framerate.
